source_summary: Chinese ink-and-color landscape with misty blue distant ridges, rounded gray-green mountains with orange mineral washes, a small pavilion hidden among pines, a lone scholar, pale water, a small boat, and foreground rocky reed banks; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_blue_tree_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the far-left misty ridge of pale blue wash with a row of dark blue conifer-like treetops rising along the skyline behind the haze.
must_preserve: soft pale blue wash fading into blank mist
irregular wet-edge silhouettes along the lower ridge
dark blue pointed treetop shapes
subtle layered transparency between nearer and farther trees

motifs.name: central_rounded_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large central rounded mountain mass, including its dark mottled summit, soft gray flanks, vertical cliff texture, and warm orange washes on the lower face.
must_preserve: rounded summit contour
granular gray-black wash texture
soft white mist breaks within the mountain face
vertical ink streaks and dry-brush rock texture
orange mineral color accents on the lower cliffs

motifs.name: right_misty_mountain_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the right-hand mountain and descending slope, with its rounded upper peak, smoky gray ink body, pale orange undertones, and feathered misty edges.
must_preserve: rounded peak profile
dark clustered ink texture near the summit and mid-slope
soft fading lower edge into mist
pale orange wash patches
broken dry-brush ridgeline and rock surface texture

motifs.name: hidden_pavilion_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion group tucked at the mountain foot, including the slanted tiled roof, dark pine clusters, tiny warm wall accents, and surrounding shrubs immediately enclosing the structure.
must_preserve: angled gray-green roof geometry with parallel tile strokes
dark black pine foliage masses above and beside the roof
small orange architectural accents
fine shrub and branch strokes around the building
mist-softened base where the pavilion sits against the slope

motifs.name: lone_scholar_figure
motifs.description: Isolate the small standing scholar below the pavilion, including the dark head and hair/hat, orange face accent, pale robe, and thin black walking lines.
must_preserve: tiny orange face accent
black head or hat shape
slender robe outline in pale gray ink
long thin black leg and staff-like strokes
delicate scale relative to the landscape

motifs.name: small_moored_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small dark boat in the lower middle water, with its narrow curved hull, orange highlights, and upright central post or mast.
must_preserve: thin crescent-shaped black hull
warm orange-brown touches along the boat
upright dark central post
small pointed ends of the hull
light surrounding water left mostly blank

motifs.name: foreground_right_rock_reed_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right foreground bank of pale rocks, ink shrubs, reeds, grasses, and scattered orange foliage accents, excluding the calligraphy and seals to the far right.
must_preserve: rounded pale rock outlines with gray wash shadows
dark clustered shrub strokes
thin reed and grass linework
small orange leaf or flower accents
soft smoky ground wash tying the rocks together

motifs.name: left_misty_water_stones
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left water surface with pale gray horizontal washes, soft mist, and a loose chain of small rounded stones near the shore.
must_preserve: broad pale gray water wash
horizontal ripple-like brush bands
fading mist edges into blank paper
small rounded ink-outlined stones
subtle shoreline transition without hard borders

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
